_why: Golden key list for the ADR-0035 job-posting-chat contracts, asserted from BOTH the TypeScript suite (ai-contracts.test.ts) and the Python suite (apps/ai-service/tests/test_contract_parity.py) so Zod and Pydantic cannot drift apart. CI runs the node and ai-service jobs independently with nothing else comparing the two, and Pydantic silently DROPS unknown request keys — so without this file, adding or renaming a field on one side only is green on both sides. NOTE: JobPostingDraft deliberately has NO org_label (ADR-0035 §Decision 3 — the payer's organisation name is never asked in the chat, never sent to an LLM, and is stamped server-side at publish from payers.orgNameEnc). If a future edit adds it, both suites go red, which is the point.
